topic.title: Organization Subscription Page
topic.shortdesc: Learn how organization administrators review subscription status, manage renewals and upgrades, and monitor license usage.

body.p: The Subscription page in allows organization administrators to review their organization's subscription status, monitor license usage, and manage subscription-related actions.

section.title: Accessing the Subscription Page
section.p: Only users with an Organization Administrator role can access the subscription management page.

ol.li: Click your user profile name in the top-right corner of the interface.
Select Manage organization from the drop-down menu.
In the organization management interface, click Subscription in the left navigation panel.

section.note: If you do not see the Manage organization option in your user menu, you do not have administrator privileges for your organization.

section.title: Page Layout and Components
section.p: The Subscription page provides information about the current subscription state and the actions available for that subscription type and status.
The subscription page is organized into two main sections:

dlentry.dd:
Displays the current subscription status, renewal information, and available management actions. This section includes:
Status indicator - A colored chip that shows the current trial or subscription state (Active, Expired, or Cancelled).
Status description - Detailed information about the subscription state and expiration or renewal date.
Action buttons - Context-sensitive buttons such as Upgrade plan, Stop Auto-renewal, Manage subscription, and Buy subscription.
Contact information - A direct link to sales support for additional assistance.

Shows the current allocation and usage of license seats for both the Author and Subject-Matter Expert (SME) platform user roles. This section includes:
Author seats - A progress bar and percentage that show the used and total Author licenses.
SME seats - A progress bar and percentage that show the used and total SME licenses.
Storage - Shows how much space (in GB) is used by the tasks, projects, and deliverables in the organization, with a percentage relative to the subscription's disk quota. For a per-project breakdown, see the Projects page in the organization administration area.

section.note: The Seat Usage section is only displayed when the subscription is active and not expired.

section.title: Subscription Status Types
section.p: The subscription can be in one of several states, each with different visual indicators and available actions:

dlentry.dd:
Indicates that the organization is currently using a trial subscription. This status shows:
A yellow/orange status chip with warning icon.
The trial expiration date information.
A Buy Subscription button to upgrade to a paid plan.

Indicates that the trial period has ended. This status shows:
A red status chip indicating the trial has expired.
The expiration date information.
A Buy Subscription button to purchase a paid plan.
A Restart Trial button (if available) to extend the trial period.

Indicates an active paid subscription. This status shows:
A green status chip indicating an active status.
The renewal date information.
Manage Subscription button to access Verifone account management.
Renew Plan button (if auto-renewal is disabled).
Stop Auto-renewal button (if auto-renewal is enabled).
Upgrade Plan button to increase the number of available seats.

Indicates that the subscription has been cancelled. This status shows:
A red status chip indicating the subscription has been cancelled.
The cancellation information.
A Buy Subscription button to purchase a new subscription.

section.title: Purchase and Management Flow
section.p: The subscription management system provides different flows based on the current subscription state:

p.b: Upgrading from Trial to Paid Subscription

section.p: For organizations with active or expired trial subscriptions:

ol.li: Click the Buy subscription button in the Subscription Status section.
You are redirected to the Verifone payment system to complete the purchase.
After successful payment, your subscription status automatically updates to Active.

section.p: For organizations with active paid subscriptions:

ol.li: Click the Manage subscription button in the Subscription Status section.
The resulting dialog box provides instructions for accessing your Verifone account. It displays your order reference number with a copy button for easy access.
Click Go to Verifone Account to open the Verifone My Account page in a new window.

In Verifone, you can:
Update payment methods.
Enable or disable auto-renewal.
View billing history.

section.p: For paid subscriptions without auto-renewal enabled, you can manually renew your subscription:

ol.li: Click the Renew plan button in the Subscription Status section.
A new browser tab opens and redirects you to the Verifone payment system.
Complete the renewal process through the Verifone checkout system using your preferred payment method.
After successful payment, you are redirected to a confirmation page.
Close the renewal tab and return to the subscription page.
Wait up to 10 minutes for the system to process the renewal and update your subscription details.
Refresh the subscription page to see the updated expiration date.

section.note: The Renew plan button is only available for paid subscriptions where auto-renewal was disabled during the original purchase. If you do not see this button, your subscription may have auto-renewal enabled or may not be eligible for manual renewal.

After you complete the renewal process, allow up to 10 minutes for the Verifone platform to send the license change notification (LCN) event to . Your subscription expiration date updates automatically once this process is complete.
section.p: For active paid subscriptions with auto-renewal enabled, you can disable automatic renewal:

ol.li: Click the Stop Auto-renewal button in the Subscription Status section.
The system immediately disables auto-renewal for your subscription.
The button disappears and your subscription status updates to reflect that auto-renewal is disabled.
You need to manually renew your subscription before the expiration date to continue using the service.

section.note: The Stop Auto-renewal button is only available for paid subscriptions purchased through the Verifone system where auto-renewal is currently enabled. Once disabled, you can re-enable auto-renewal through your Verifone account management interface.
When you delete the organization, if auto-renewal is enabled, the system automatically disables it as part of the deletion process.
section.p: For active paid subscriptions, you can upgrade your plan to increase the number of available seats for both the Author and Subject-Matter Expert (SME) platform user roles:

ol.li: Click the Upgrade plan button in the Subscription Status section.
The Upgrade Subscription dialog box opens and shows your current seat allocation.

In the dialog box, specify the new number of seats for each role type:
Author Seats - Enter the desired number of Author licenses. The value must be equal to or greater than your current allocation.
SME Seats - Enter the desired number of SME licenses. The value must be equal to or greater than your current allocation.
Review the seat counts to ensure they meet your organization's needs.
Click Continue to proceed with the upgrade.
A new browser tab opens and redirects you to the Verifone payment system to complete the upgrade purchase.
Complete the upgrade process through the Verifone checkout system using your preferred payment method.
After successful payment, you are redirected to a confirmation page.
Close the upgrade tab and return to the subscription page.
Wait up to 10 minutes for the system to process the upgrade and update your subscription details.
Refresh the subscription page to see the updated seat allocation in the Seat Usage section.

section.note: The Upgrade plan button is only available for active paid subscriptions with Verifone account information. You cannot downgrade your subscription through this interface. Upgrades can only increase the number of available seats.

After you complete the upgrade process, allow up to 10 minutes for the Verifone platform to send the license change notification (LCN) event to . Your seat allocation updates automatically once this process is complete.

section.title: License Usage Monitoring
section.p: The Seat Usage section provides real-time monitoring of license consumption:

dlentry.dd:
Shows the usage of Content Fusion Author licenses, which are user-based. The display includes:
Number of active Author users out of total available.
Visual progress bar indicating usage percentage.
Percentage display for quick reference.

Shows the usage of Subject-Matter Expert licenses, which operate on a floating seat model. The display includes:
Number of active SME users out of total available.
Visual progress bar indicating usage percentage.
Percentage display for quick reference.

section.p: License usage is calculated based on:

ul.li: Active members - Users who are currently active in the organization.
Pending invitations - Users who have been invited but not yet accepted.
Platform user role assignment - Whether users are assigned the Author or Subject-Matter Expert (SME) platform user role.

section.note: Inactive users do not count against license limits, but their data remains intact and can be reactivated by an administrator.

section.title: Cancelling Subscriptions
section.p: German shoppers (localized via billing address country) can cancel their subscriptions by themselves from their Verifone MyAccount. Others should contact their payment provider.
To cancel a subscription, contact the payment provider, or use Verifone with these instructions:

ol.li: Click the Manage subscription button in the Subscription Status section on the Subscription page.
The resulting dialog box provides instructions for accessing your Verifone account.
Click Go to Verifone Account to open the Verifone My Account page in a new window.
Schedule a cancellation.

section.title: Organization Impact After Subscription Expiration / Cancellation

p.b: What Happens When a Subscription Expires or is Cancelled?

ul.li: Organization Suspension - When a subscription expires or becomes cancelled, either manually by the user or through the payment provider, the organization automatically enters a suspended state. This suspension prevents normal access to the organization's resources and data.
Subscription Status Visibility - The expired or cancelled status is clearly displayed on the organization's Subscription page, showing users that their subscription is no longer active.

For Organization Administrators - When an administrator logs in to a suspended organization, they are automatically redirected to the Subscription page so they can review the subscription status and take action.

For Organization Members (Non-Administrators) - Regular members who log in to a suspended organization see an informational page that explains the current situation and why they cannot access their usual workspace.

Automatic Reactivation - When a new subscription becomes active, through purchase or reactivation, the organization is automatically restored to normal operation. The suspension is lifted, and all users regain full access to the organization's resources.

Manual Subscription Renewal - Administrators have access to a Renew plan button on the Subscription page when the organization is suspended due to subscription expiration. This button opens the subscription renewal flow.

Purchase New Subscription - Administrators have access to a Buy subscription button on the Subscription page when the organization is suspended due to subscription cancellation. This button opens the subscription purchase flow.

section.title: Troubleshooting and Support
section.p: If you encounter issues with subscription management:

ul.li: Contact Sales - Use the contact information provided on the subscription page for direct assistance with subscription-related questions.
Organization Access - Ensure you have Organization Administrator privileges to access subscription management features.

Upgrade Issues - If the Upgrade plan button is not visible, verify that your subscription is active and paid. The upgrade feature is only available for paid subscriptions with Verifone account information.
Seat Validation - When upgrading, ensure that the new seat counts are equal to or greater than your current allocation. The system prevents downgrades through the upgrade interface.

Processing Delays - After you complete an upgrade, allow up to 10 minutes for the system to process the changes. If seat allocation does not update after this time, refresh the page or contact support.
